questions.stem: According to the cohesion-tension theory, what is the main force that pulls water up through the xylem?

options.text: Transpiration pull created by evaporation from leaf surfaces
Gravity pulling water down from the atmosphere

questions.explanation: The main driving force is transpiration pull. As water evaporates from mesophyll cells in the leaf, it creates tension (negative pressure) that pulls water up through the continuous column in the xylem.
